resources.string: Volume Up = one tap at your chosen spot

Turns each Volume Up press into exactly one tap at the point you choose with the floating marker.

Volume Up is intercepted only while the clicker is ARMED, so it does not change the volume then. Volume Down is never intercepted. In every other state both volume keys work normally.

This service does not read screen content and collects no data. It has no internet access.
One Volume Up press = one tap at your target.
OFF: turn on Full Auto Clicker in Accessibility settings
ON in settings but not running. Turn it off and on again.

Samsung: Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Full Auto Clicker → On.

If the switch is greyed out or says "Restricted setting" (Android 13+ for apps not installed from a store): open App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.

Recommended: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Full Auto Clicker.
SELECTING: drag the marker, then press READY.
ARMED at %1$d, %2$d: each Volume Up press taps once.
PAUSED: screen rotated since READY (target %1$d, %2$d). Volume Up works normally until you rotate back.

Tap the floating circle → START → drag the marker onto the spot → READY. The marker disappears and its position is kept. Each Volume Up press then taps there once; holding the key does not repeat. Volume Down always changes volume. STOP, screen off, or turning the service off disarms immediately; nothing re-arms by itself.
This settings screen is not available on this device.
